Mission: Ensuring quality care and treatment of horses through intervention, education, and outreach.

www.defhr.org

Days End Farm Horse Rescue, Inc. is a 501c3 non-profit equine rescue and rehabilitation organization founded in 1989 with a mission to foster compassion and responsibility through intervention, education, and outreach. All horses that arrive at DEFHR are seized by animal control for varying degrees of abuse and/or neglect and all are in need of rehabilitation. Once the horses are rehabilitated and evaluated, they are made available for adoption. This channel was made to promote those horses currently looking for their new homes.
